metadata.title: Semiconductor stocks rebound, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
July 21, 6:31am ET
Semiconductor stocks rebound, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Tuesday's premarket action:
Shares of semiconductor companies are jumping after recent selling saw the sector fall 20% from its recent high. Marvell Technology is up 7%, Micron Technology is surging 6% and Intel is adding 6% to recover the $100 mark.
A theme of trading in recent weeks is that if the chips are up then software tends to go down. So it is early Tuesday, with Workday falling 4% and Intuit off nearly 5%.
Zions Bancorp shares are down 4% after a jump in earnings was not enough to support a stock that is up 23% so far in 2026.
Adobe shares are down 4% after Morgan Stanley downgraded the stock to underweight and reduced its price target to $240 from $365.
Danaher shares are sliding more than 8% as the company's earnings report appears not to have been well received by investors early Tuesday.
